name: Kyle Flynn
subtitle: Finance Professional & Sports Analyst
bio: I'm a finance professional pursuing a career in sports operations and analytics. This blog covers data, strategy and the business side of professional baseball and professional hockey, using Python, SQL and AI tools to uncover insights that reflect how professional front offices think and make decisions. My strongest skill is communication. I can explain this analysis just as clearly to someone who works with the data every day as to someone who has never seen it before.
